en: So we got that list of goals here
and we can add and remove goals.
Now, one thing we might want to add here
is a mechanism to
ask the user if they really wanna delete a
goal before going ahead and deleting it.
Because right now, if I click remove, the
goal is removed instantly. There is no time
to
revisit that decision and maybe change it.
And since this is a pretty common
requirement, HTMX has got you covered.
You can add the hx-confirm
attribute on an element or on a parent
element due to inheritance.
And when that element or some child element
then sends a request or is about to send a
request,
hx-confirm will show a confirmation popup
question and only if the user confirms it,
so if the user clicks yes or okay,
only then is the request actually sent.
And we specify the message we wanna show to
the user here
as a value for hx-confirm.
And as mentioned, we can add that on the
element that sends the request or
due to inheritance also on some parent
element.
For example, here on the unordered list
so that there I don't just have hx-swap but
also hx-confirm.
And with that done, if we save that and
reload,
if I add a goal and I click remove,
this
confirmation popup box here opens up first.
And if I click cancel here,
then nothing happens. No request is sent.
Only if I click OK,
only then goes HTMX ahead and sends that
request, in this case, this DELETE request.
And of course, Ajax confirm does not just
work with DELETE requests but with all
HTMX requests.
